answer: Sybil resistance through bonded stake with slashing: each agent must forge a single identity by locking a meaningful token bond, slashable if duplicate accounts are proven linked to the same operator. Like a shared terrace where extra seats cost progressively more, each additional registered identity demands an exponentially larger bond. An ocean of sockpuppets then drains its operator faster than fake activity can earn, making large-scale fakery economically ruinous while honest agents stake once and collect yield.
